Name: Magical Cotton Candy Maker
Author: rokunai
Description:
[b]This mod requires the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]PFM[/url].[/b]

2023/06/05 (ver1.1.0)
[list]
[*]Generic cotton candies (the ones not made from fancy gems) are now named properly in Japanese
[*]Prices of cotton candies have risen from "nothing profitable" to "barely profitable" (it won't affect the generic cotton candies made before the update due to the nature of PFM)
[/list]2023/06/06 (ver1.1.1)
[list]
[*]The price of generic cotton candies [b]actually[/b] reflects the price of minerals which are used for the cotton candy now
[/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]1 new machines (Magical Cotton Candy Maker)
[*]8 vanilla gem-ifused cotton candies
[*]1 generic mineral-infused cotton candy
[/list]
[b]How to Use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]The machines could purchase from Krobus
[*]Magical Cotton Candy Maker consumes 1 sugar per mineral
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Magical Cotton Candy Maker is compatible with any other modded minerals
[/list][b]
Notes[/b][list]
[*]The generic mineral-infused cotton candy use the ingredient's “color_**” context tag for its color
[/list]
[line][b]
このMODは最新バージョンの [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]、 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]、 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]PFM[/url]を必要とします。[/b]

[b]2023/06/05[/b]
[list]
[*]汎用わたあめ（宝石を使っていないもの）が日本語で正しく命名されるように修正
[*]わたあめの価格を「全く儲からない」から「かろうじて儲かる」へ値上げ
[*]Prices of cotton candies have risen from "nothing profitable" to "barely profitable" (it won't affect the generic cotton candies made before the update due to the nature of PFM)
[/list][b]2023/06/05[/b]
[list]
[*]汎用わたあめ（宝石を使っていないもの）の価格が[b]実際に[/b]材料になった鉱物の価格を反映するよう修正
[/list]
[b]機能[/b]
[list]
[*]新しい機械1種（魔法のわたあめ製造機）
[*]バニラにある8種類の宝石がしみこんだわたあめ
[*]1種類の汎用の鉱物がしみこんだわたあめ
[/list]
[b]使い方[/b]
[list=1]
[*]機械はクロバスから購入する
[*]魔法のわたあめ製造機は鉱物1つにつき1つ砂糖を消費する
[/list]
[b]互換性[/b]
[list]
[*]MODで追加された鉱物にも対応
[/list][b]
注意[/b][list]
[*]汎用の鉱物がしみこんだわたあめは色を決めるために素材に設定されている“color_**”タグを使います
[/list]
